unlockAfterShift.description: Customers start leaving reviews once this many shifts are finished.

reviewChance.description: Chance that a customer who leaves the shop writes a review (0.125 is about 1 in 8).

ratingWindow.description: The store's rating is the average of this many most recent reviews.

maxSavedReviews.description: Oldest reviews are dropped past this many so saves stay small.

longWaitFraction.description: Waiting in line longer than this share of the customer's patience counts as a long wait.

someWaitFraction.description: Waiting in line longer than this share of the customer's patience counts as a noticeable wait.

fastCheckoutFraction.description: Paying after waiting less than this share of the customer's patience counts as a fast checkout.

crowdedLinePosition.description: Joining the line with at least this many people ahead counts as a crowded shop.

huntingShelfCount.description: Needing this many different shelves for one shopping list counts as items being hard to find.

gorgeousMargin.description: Presentation this many points above what the customer expected counts as a beautiful shop.
